_note: v0.2 (10 Nov 2026), validated by Ethan after the 26 Oct - 10 Nov review: sanctions, trade, carriers, regulation and weather tightened. Every parenthesised group must match (title, URL words, organisations).

conflict.label: Geopolitics and conflict
conflict.query: ("Red Sea" OR Houthi OR "Bab el-Mandeb" OR "Strait of Hormuz" OR "Taiwan Strait") (ship OR vessel OR tanker OR "container ship" OR shipping)

sanctions.label: Sanctions and diplomacy
sanctions.query: (sanctions OR ceasefire OR "peace deal" OR "peace talks" OR embargo OR blockade) (shipping OR tanker OR tankers OR vessel OR vessels OR "shadow fleet" OR "Red Sea" OR "Strait of Hormuz" OR Houthi OR Houthis OR strait)

trade.label: Trade and tariffs
trade.query: (tariff OR tariffs OR "anti-dumping" OR "anti-subsidy" OR "trade deal" OR "trade defence" OR "trade defense" OR safeguard OR safeguards OR countermeasures OR "kill switch") (China OR Chinese OR Beijing OR EU OR "European Union" OR Brussels OR European) (imports OR exports OR trade OR goods)

economy.label: Economy and demand
economy.query: ("China exports" OR "export orders" OR PMI OR "consumer demand" OR "retail inventories") (Europe OR China)

carriers.label: Carrier decisions
carriers.query: (Maersk OR MSC OR "CMA CGM" OR "Hapag-Lloyd" OR COSCO OR "Ocean Network Express" OR "Premier Alliance" OR "Gemini Cooperation" OR Evergreen OR "Yang Ming" OR HMM) ("rate increase" OR "general rate" OR "blank sailing" OR "blank sailings" OR Suez OR "Red Sea" OR "Cape of Good Hope" OR reroute OR rerouting OR resume OR resumes OR FAK OR surcharge) (ship OR ships OR shipping OR vessel OR vessels OR container OR containers OR carrier OR carriers OR line OR service)

ports.label: Ports and logistics
ports.query: (port OR terminal OR dockworkers) (strike OR congestion OR fire OR closure OR outage) (Rotterdam OR Antwerp OR Hamburg OR Genoa OR Piraeus OR Singapore OR Colombo OR Shanghai OR Ningbo OR Jeddah)

energy.label: Energy and fuel
energy.query: (OPEC OR "oil price" OR "bunker fuel" OR "Brent crude") (shipping OR freight OR tanker)

regulation.label: Regulation
regulation.query: ("EU ETS" OR "emissions trading" OR FuelEU OR "International Maritime Organization" OR "net-zero framework" OR "carbon levy") (shipping OR maritime OR carriers OR vessels)

calendar.label: Calendar and seasonality
calendar.query: ("Chinese New Year" OR "Lunar New Year" OR "Golden Week" OR "peak season") (shipping OR freight OR factories OR containers)

weather.label: Weather and climate
weather.query: (typhoon OR cyclone OR storm OR storms OR drought OR fog OR swell) (port OR ports OR shipping OR vessels OR "container ship" OR "Cape of Good Hope" OR "Panama Canal") (closed OR closure OR closes OR suspended OR suspends OR delays OR delayed OR disrupted OR disruption OR halted)

zones.red_sea_suez: Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb, Suez Canal

intensity_scale.1: Minor: local or short-lived event, no capacity change expected
intensity_scale.2: Material: affects several services, a route or a large port for days to weeks
intensity_scale.3: Major: closes or reopens a route, or moves a large share of capacity
